Canatu is a carbon nanomaterial developer. We create the most advanced carbon nanotubes for industry-transforming products.

Explore career opportunities in nanotechnology at Canatu. We work on forward-looking issues with some of the most exciting companies in the world. Join us to transform products for better tomorrows with nano carbon while also advancing your career and personal growth.
We are all about making things future-proof. Whether working with partners on new solutions or developing our operations, a more sustainable future guides our actions.

Canatu is the global leader in advanced CNT. We at Canatu think big and create massive impact on the tiniest scale. What we create becomes part of solutions with the power to transform products, industries and even everyday life.

Carbon is a future-proof material. It is a sustainable alternative to e.g. materials that are mined, and it is ideal for the circular economy. Carbon is available everywhere, which makes it safe from monopolization or cartelling.

The companies we collaborate with are forerunners, who are redefining their industries. Together we work on whatever will make the leap ahead possible, leading to better products with a transformative impact. These projects involve several partners working in collaboration to achieve our aim.
By combining our varied expertise, we make an impact in people’s working life and the everyday. Transforming products for better tomorrow with nano carbon.

Transforming products for better tomorrows

Your journey to shaping a better world starts here! We are driven by our passion to solve world-scale problems at the smallest scale imaginable – the nanoscale. At Canatu we think big and create massive impacts on the tiniest scale – nano solutions for positive impact.

Our purpose is to transform products for better tomorrows with nano carbon. We currently operate in the automotive and semiconductor industries, with ongoing expansion into medical diagnostics. Our unique technology ensures versatility and reliability for various highly engineered solutions.

We are expanding fast and continuously looking for fresh talents to be part of our growth. Our team thrives on curiosity, collaborates for impact, and has a passion for progress. We aim to sustain our high team spirit and are in search of individuals with a positive, can-do attitude to enrich our team. Could you be the one we’re seeking?

As a tight-knit team, we embark on cross-functional projects, embracing the opportunities to share our knowledge and learn from the others. Our passion to progress keeps us going and infuses joy into our daily work. We embrace cultural diversity, as mirrored by our team members representing 26 nationalities.
Our vibrant team is a unique blend of 116 professionals representing 26 nationalities.

Our team has expertise in physics, chemistry, material science, nanotechnology, product management, project management, sales, marketing, manufacturing, supply chain and much more. Our company language is English, and the most of our roles are situated at our headquarters in Vantaa, Finland.

“The company is quite diverse with people of different nationalities and races. However, I was pleasantly surprised to find that my colleagues at Canatu were very open and friendly.”

Carbon nanotubes are the most versatile material in the universe. At Canatu, our vision is to create the most advanced carbon nanotubes for industry-transforming products.

There is immense potential in carbon nanotubes. Their incomparable properties increasingly suit different kinds of products. The more we harness nanotechnology across various industries, the more commonplace carbon nanotubes become in products we use in our everyday.

At Canatu, we focus on creating the most advanced carbon nanotubes for industry-transforming products. Canatu CNT is highly developed and answers the high standards of forerunner companies, providing consistent quality, reliability and performance.
Canatu CNT properties

The unique properties of carbon nanotubes make them a versatile building block of the modern world, benefiting a vast range of industrial applications. Carbon nanotubes have excellent mechanical, electrical, thermal, optical, and chemical properties.

Canatu’s unique process is the secret to creating the most advanced carbon nanotubes for highly-engineered products. How we make Canatu CNT yields properties that make it applicable for a variety of industry-redefining products now and in the future.

Canatu has the expertise to effectively adapt carbon nanotubes for different contexts and uses. The customizability and versatility of our synthesis process makes Canatu CNT ideal for highly engineered solutions.
